notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Barbed Servitor.
description:
Deal damage to Barbed Servitor
Barbed Servitor and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Barbed Servitor trigger, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt to Barbed Servitor.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Barbed Servitor instead due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.
